description: This file defines the HolidayMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. Its main responsibility is to configure the holiday menu by overriding the screen to 'viewHolidayList'.

classes.name: HolidayMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the leave plugin menu for holidays by overriding the screen to 'viewHolidayList'. Implements MenuConfigurator.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewHolidayList' for the leave module's holiday menu.
